page.title: Infrastructure
page.introDescription: We uphold the pinnacle of manufacturing resilience, quality, and operational continuity. Equipped with cutting-edge machinery, redundant backup processing lines, and uninterrupted power protocols from CNC cutting to forced-convection tempering, we guarantee reliable project execution without single-point failure risks.

industries.title: Cutting & Processing
industries.subtitle: PRECISION CNC GLASS CUTTING
industries.specs: Dual CNC Cutting Lines & Automatic Loading Bridges (Full Backup Redundancy)
industries.description:
Our processing floor operates dual automated CNC glass cutting lines equipped with automatic loading bridges and dedicated backup cutting tables.

This redundant configuration guarantees 100% operational continuity during scheduled maintenance and volume surges, eliminating single points of failure from raw float cutting through precision edge processing.

industries.title: Toughening Plant
industries.subtitle: FORCED CONVECTION FURNACE
industries.specs: Twin Forced-Convection Furnaces & Dedicated Generator Backup
industries.description:
Our tempering infrastructure features twin advanced forced-convection furnaces, providing immediate contingency load rerouting and eliminating production bottlenecks.

Backed by dedicated uninterrupted power supply (UPS), industrial diesel generators, and redundant high-pressure air compressor banks, our furnaces safeguard critical air-quench cycles against any power or equipment interruption.

industries.title: Lamination & Cleanroom
industries.subtitle: PVB & SENTRYGLAS® LAMINATING
industries.specs: Cleanroom Autoclave & Vacuum Bag Lamination (Max 4000 × 2500 mm)
industries.description:
Our dust-free, climate-controlled cleanroom facilities feature high-pressure autoclave lines and specialized vacuum bag lamination (up to 4000 × 2500 mm), ensuring flawless bonding of PVB, EVA, and SentryGlas® interlayers.

This dual-method capability guarantees high-impact security glass for prestigious architectural facades and oversized structural installations.

industries.title: Double Glazing (DGU)
industries.subtitle: INSULATED GLASS MANUFACTURING
industries.specs: Robotic DGU Sealing Line (Max 3600 × 2400 mm) & ≥90% Argon Gas Filling
industries.description:
Equipped with automated robotic DGU assembly lines handling units up to 3600 × 2400 mm, we provide precision dual structural silicone sealing and high-concentration argon gas filling (≥90% per EN 1279).

Engineered to withstand harsh environmental conditions while drastically reducing building HVAC energy load.

industries.title: Quality Control Center
industries.subtitle: COMPREHENSIVE QUALITY ASSURANCE
industries.description:
From raw material inception to final dispatch, every glass unit undergoes stringent multi-stage inspection.

Our commitment to quality ensures every pane delivered meets international safety and architectural standards.
